content_text:
Hello Team Deakins!
I had an incredible experience watching Nineteen Eighty-Four today. I love the feelings of entrapment and surveillance especially with wide shots, it’s amazing how you can craft such incredibly claustrophobic frames in such wide shots.
I was looking through the credits list and saw Dick Pope was a Camera Operator for the film? I would love to hear which shots of this is true and if so how was the experience working with him?
